summary: Completed testing of P1 features: Analytics Dashboard and Notes Search. Fixed critical backend bug where /api/notes/search was returning 404 due to route ordering issue. All 16 backend tests pass (100%). All frontend tests pass for Analytics page (stat cards, charts, navigation) and Notes search (filtering, clear, empty state).

GET /api/analytics returns note_type_breakdown array with type and count
GET /api/analytics returns quiz_type_breakdown array
GET /api/analytics returns activity_timeline array with date and activity counts
GET /api/notes/search (no query) returns all notes

GET /api/notes/search?q=xyznonexistent returns empty array

Analytics page shows Quizzes Taken stat (16)

Analytics page shows Top Subjects bar chart

Analytics nav hidden on landing page (minimal header)

seed_data_creation: None - used existing data (31 notes, 12 plans, 3 exam plans, 16 quizzes)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two P1 features fully tested and working: 1) Analytics Dashboard at /analytics shows totals, subject breakdown bar chart, note type percentages, and 30-day activity timeline. 2) Notes search in sidebar filters by subject/chapter/note_type with clear button and empty state message. Fixed route ordering bug in server.py - /api/notes/search must be defined BEFORE /api/notes/{note_id} to avoid 404.

bug_fix_applied.root_cause: FastAPI route ordering - /api/notes/{note_id} was defined before /api/notes/search, so 'search' was being treated as a note_id
bug_fix_applied.fix: Moved /api/notes/search route definition BEFORE /api/notes/{note_id} in server.py (around line 576)
bug_fix_applied.verification: All 5 search endpoint tests now pass
